blocks.text: Kickoff the football fun and jump in the game today with the NERF Pro Grip Kids Foam Football! These junior footballs are constructed with NERF semi-soft foam so all players can have fun playing football indoors and out. Designed for smaller hands, this 9" inch junior sized football is easy for kids to grip, throw and catch so they can easily get in on the football fun. The soft foam interior is protected by an outer layer that helps make this ball perfect for both indoor and outdoor football games. Fun and durable enough for indoor and outdoor games in the backyard or at the beach, the NERF Pro Grip Kids Football is the perfect football to take on the go anywhere. This ball is perfect for touch football games at the park, playing catch at the tailgate, or helping kids practice the basics while having a ton of fun. If your kids are ready to get in the action or kickoff their football careers, grab them a NERF Pro Grip Kids Foam Football and start playing today!
